intent.stated: use the correct timezone of user for date overrides
intent.note: The change attempts to make date overrides timezone-aware and to gate fixed-host round-robin slots on the fixed host's actual availability, but the new `checkIfIsAvailable` logic contains a copy-paste bug that breaks the working-hours check for every non-override slot, the date-override window test has an always-false `===` comparison, and the one test added as proof of the timezone fix asserts the same UTC output as the unchanged-timezone case — so it would pass on the old code and does not verify the fix.

review: **Scope:** Reviewed `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts`, `packages/lib/slots.ts`, `packages/types/schedule.d.ts`, and `apps/web/test/lib/getSchedule.test.ts` against the `getSchedule` callers and the `getSlots`/`buildSlots` pipeline. Could not run the test suite to confirm runtime behavior, and could not verify dayjs's `.tz(undefined)` semantics against the library source in this repository.
